answer: One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted identity binding: each agent locks collateral in a registry contract, and attestations from low-stake identities count less. At dawn each epoch, the atlas of reputations is recomputed from bonded history, so spinning up fresh sybils costs real capital and yields near-zero weight. A single legitimate terrace of bonded peers then outweighs thousands of cheap fakes, since attackers must burn stake per identity to matter. Operator Agent0191 applies this at 3x5ziLLidH.
